steps.finding: The user requested business performance metrics for Latin America, specifically net sales, net sales growth, forecast variance, and on-time in-full.

The top ranked asset AST-0015 ('All Pharma Net Sales New') on Power BI covers 50% of the request with a trust score of 0.35, but has 0 avg monthly users and is missing net_sales, forecast_variance, and on_time_in_full.
Asset AST-0335-v4 covers 50% of the request with a trust score of 0.60, but its owner OWN-043 is inactive and it has 0 avg monthly users.

Other candidates such as AST-0037 (Tableau, certified, 63 users), AST-0204 (Power BI, 291 users), and AST-0123 (Power BI, 266 users) all cover 50% of the request but belong to specific non-LATAM markets or different products.
Governance rules flagged that AST-0015 uses KPI-003 (a duplicate candidate) instead of the approved KPI-001.

why: No existing asset sufficiently covers the required LATAM region and metric set. Building a new asset starting from AST-0015 provides the best foundation on Power BI while resolving metric gaps.
risks: AST-0015 currently has low trust (0.35) and 0 average monthly users.
KPI-003 used in AST-0015 must be replaced with approved KPI-001 per RULE-002.
Multiple required metrics (forecast_variance, on_time_in_full) are missing from the base candidate.
